Chicken Breast Large at Harvest Lane Juniper Bay Superstore II is likely to run out because only 9 units are on hand against 33.5 units of forecast demand in the 4-day window, driven by a promotion adding 16 units over usual, a recent surge to 7.1 units/day from 4.9/day, and 20 inbound units now projected 3 days late. Expedite 20 units through Evergreen Meat Foods to cover delayed PO units before the window closes.
failing_examples.judge_issue: The note says the 20 inbound units are "projected 3 days late". The facts say they are "now projected in 3 days", meaning they arrive in 3 days, not that they are 3 days late. This misstates a number. The other figures (9 on hand, 33.5 forecast, +16 promotion, 7.1 vs 4.9 per day) and the action (expedite 20 units with Evergreen Meat Foods) match the facts.
